question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who can speak two languages
solution: The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'Bilingual.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let's look at the meaning of the marked option: • **Bilingual**- able to speak and understand two languages fluently. (द्विभाषी) • Example: • *She is **bilingual** in English and Punjabi.* • ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:​ • **Multilingual**- able to speak and understand multiple languages. (बहुभाषी) • **Trilingual**- able to speak and understand three languages fluently. (त्रिभाषी) • **Monolingual**- able to speak and understand only one language. (एकभाषी) • Hence, from the given meanings, we find that 'Bilingual' is the correct one-word substitute. • So, the correct answer is option 2. 1c8:Ta450,
